title: P1 Remediation: I/O Sandwich Subgraph Bounds, LocalAuthCache Zero-Clone, Ingest Hash Verification & Redaction Rule 11
public_safety_audit_summary: Critical (OOM / Async Executor Starvation & Silent Ingest Bypass): Unbounded LocalAuthCache and synchronous I/O Sandwich risk OOM and Tokio starvation on 10^4+ event forks (F-03.2, F-03.5); optional hashes at ingest and no-op EventVerifier defaults risk silent verification bypass (F-06-03, F-06-04).
